verdict.rationale: Railway is a cloud deployment platform, so a durable-workflow primitive is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack never describes workflows-as-code, durable execution, or built-in queue/retry handling. Persistent cloud-agent machines, replicas and rollbacks are adjacent features and do not deliver this story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can deploy durable, long-running workflows as code without manually wiring queues and retries
